nsofa.l: Is the infant intubated? The SpO2 to FiO2 ratio is scored only if yes; if no, the respiratory domain is 0 regardless of oxygen requirement
SpO2. Required only when intubated, because the ratio is not scored otherwise
FiO2 as a FRACTION, for example 0.40 for 40 percent - sending 40 would compute a ratio a hundred times too small. Required only when intubated
Number of inotropes [0 = None; 1 = One; 2 = Two or more]
Platelet count. 150 or above scores 0, 100 to 149 scores 1, below 100 scores 2, below 50 scores 3
